# FDGA044

> DO use collection initializers where possible.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.6 Other.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0028
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
dotnet_style_collection_initializer = true
dotnet_style_prefer_collection_expression = never
```

## From the book

```csharp
Right:
     SomeCollection someColl = new SomeCollection
     {
         first,
         second,
         third,
     };

Not preferred:
    SomeCollection someColl = new SomeCollection();
    someColl.Add(first);
    someColl.Add(second);
    someColl.Add(third);
```
